design_notes: Primary visual language should match console 2026 refresh: rounded cards, muted gradient hero, monospace code tiles with subtle shadows.
Auth flow uses 3-step micro-illustration: obtain token, store securely, rotate via refresh endpoint. Keep copy under 12 words per card.
Streaming snippet intentionally shows partial output lines and a small progress spinner — avoid using brand-specific example data; use lorem-style safe placeholders.
Toolcalling illustration must depict request -> function manifest -> response with typed arguments. Use the new function icon set from assets/icons/functions-v2.
